About Us

Who we are

As one of the leading accommodation providers in Prague since 2014, we take pride in offering over 200 vacation homes that meet the highest standards of comfort and luxury.

Our commitment to innovation makes us a leader on the Czech market greatly surpassing all of our competitors in terms of revenue and average annual occupancy of over 93%.

Our nightly rates are determined by precise data analysis, including guest demand, property availability, and local events, ensuring competitive pricing for every stay.

Guests have access to a diverse range of properties, from cozy retreats to spacious family-friendly apartments, available through our direct partnerships with leading platforms like Airbnb, and Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Agoda. Our website dwellfort.com offers our guests a discounts of up to 20% from the cheapest rates on all of those platforms.

Upon arrival, our guests can expect clean, comfortable, and well-maintained homes equipped with secure e-locks. Our round-the-clock on-the-ground support ensures a seamless experience for every stay, providing peace of mind and guaranteeing a five-star experience from start to finish.
